name: Anchor and alias
forms: inspect, rename, assign, explode; graph identity retained

name: Assign and update
forms: absolute, relative, and compound assignment across multiple paths

name: Boolean
forms: and, or, not, any, all, any_c, all_c

name: Column
forms: exact value and key columns in block and multiline flow YAML; generated nodes return 0

name: Comments
forms: read/write head, line, and foot comments on values and keys; strict block-source edits

name: Create object
forms: literal and computed keys; stream values

name: Date and time
forms: calendar and timezone operators are not implemented

name: Delete
forms: del, delpaths, mapping and sequence targets

name: Encode and decode
forms: from_json, from_yaml, from_toml, from_ini, from_xml, from_props, from_csv, from_tsv; matching to_* and shorthand forms; Base64, URI, shell

name: Environment
forms: env, strenv, envsubst options; disable switch

name: Eval
forms: eval(EXPR) compiles YAML.sh expressions dynamically with node and depth ceilings

name: File context
forms: filename, fileIndex, multi-file and writable eval-all context

name: Has
forms: mapping keys and positive/negative sequence indexes

name: Line
forms: one-based source line, 0 for generated nodes

name: Load
forms: load, load_str, load_base64, load_props; byte ceiling and disable switch

name: Map
forms: map, map_values, mapping and sequence inputs

name: Omit
forms: selected mapping keys or sequence indexes

name: Path
forms: path lookup plus setpath and delpaths

name: Pick
forms: selected mapping keys or sequence indexes

name: Pivot
forms: rectangular and ragged sequences; map rows

name: Recursive descent
forms: .., optional traversal, recursive selection and updates

name: Root
forms: graph/document root from any selected descendant

name: Shuffle
forms: portable Fisher-Yates shuffle; --shuffle-seed supplies reproducible runs

name: Slice array
forms: positive, negative, and open sequence slices

name: Split into documents
forms: split_doc is explicit and idempotent; YAML streams are always document-separated

name: Strings
forms: interpolation, string slices, case, trim, to_string, split/join, contains/prefix/suffix, POSIX test/sub

name: Style
forms: scalar and collection style read/write; source compiler decides preservation

name: Traverse
forms: keys, dynamic keys, indexes, splats, optional traversal

name: Variables
forms: value bindings, ref, dynamic lookup, reducer bindings

name: With
forms: scoped updates over one or many matches
